fields.name: title
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: A short headline about the challenge.

fields.name: tag
fields.label: Topic
fields.description: Pick the closest topic. This is what the filter buttons use.

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Card teaser
fields.description: One or two sentences shown on the story card.

fields.name: going
fields.label: What was going on
fields.description: The parent's words. 3 to 5 sentences. Do not include quotation marks.

fields.name: worked
fields.label: What we worked on
fields.description: The parent's words. 3 to 5 sentences.

fields.name: now
fields.label: How it feels now
fields.description: The parent's words. 3 to 5 sentences.

fields.name: serviceLabel
fields.label: Related service
fields.description: Shown in a box at the end of the story with a "Learn more" button. The button goes to the right page automatically.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Keep hidden (draft)
fields.description: Turn this OFF only when the parent has approved the final wording in writing. Hidden stories do not appear on the site.

fields.name: sample
fields.label: This is a sample story
fields.description: Leave ON for placeholder stories. Turn OFF for real stories. Sample stories are labeled and hidden from Google.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: Google title (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use the headline.

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.label: Google description (optional)
fields.description: One sentence for search results.

fields.name: color
fields.label: Card color
fields.description: Background color of this story on the Stories page.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Position on the Stories page
fields.description: 1 = top of the page. Lower numbers appear first.

fields.name: cancelledDates
fields.label: Cancelled dates
fields.description: Add a date to remove it from the regular schedule, for example a holiday.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-02

fields.name: note
fields.label: Reason (optional, for your own reference)
fields.description: For example: Thanksgiving week

fields.name: extraDates
fields.label: Extra dates
fields.description: One-off sessions that are not on the regular schedule.

fields.label: Date
fields.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-10

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note (optional)
fields.description: For example: Guest speaker

fields.name: scheduleLabel
fields.label: Schedule label (shown on the site)
fields.description: For example: 1st + 3rd Wednesdays

fields.name: timeLabel
fields.label: Time label (shown on the site)
fields.description: For example: 10am to 12pm

fields.name: services
fields.label: Services
fields.description: Your main services. Each one is a card on the home page and an expandable section on the Services page. Drag to reorder.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Service name
fields.description: Full name, shown on the Services page. For example: Tongue tie assessment + support

fields.name: shortTitle
fields.label: Short name (home page card)
fields.description: A shorter version for the home page card. For example: Tongue tie

fields.name: homeBlurb
fields.label: Home page card text
fields.description: One or two sentences.

fields.name: homeMeta
fields.label: Session length (home page card)
fields.description: For example: 60 to 90 minutes

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle (Services page)
fields.description: Shown under the name on the Services page.

fields.name: num
fields.label: Number
fields.description: Shown in the circle next to the name. For example: 01

fields.name: color
fields.label: Card color
fields.description: Background of the home page card, and the circle behind the number on the Services page.

fields.name: open
fields.label: Start opened on the Services page
fields.description: Usually only the first service.

fields.name: left
fields.label: Details: left column
fields.description: Shown when the service is opened on the Services page.

fields.name: right
fields.label: Details: right column
fields.description: The checklist on the right when the service is opened. For example: What we cover.

fields.name: cashRate
fields.label: Price (Services page, "Payment + insurance" box)
fields.description: The large price near the bottom of the Services page. For example: $200

fields.name: insurance
fields.label: Insurance accepted (Services page, "Payment + insurance" box)
fields.description: Small tags under the price. One plan per line.

fields.name: pills
fields.label: Quick facts under the Services page title
fields.description: The row of small rounded tags just under the big Services page heading. Keep each one short. Update these if the price or insurance changes.

fields.name: also
fields.label: Other things you help with (Services page)
fields.description: Tags shown after the list of services, next to "Also supporting".

fields.name: linkHref
fields.label: Link address (optional)
fields.description: For example: /bloom-circle

fields.name: items
